title: Whispers from the Liminal — ep. 19 · a field guide, left on a park bench

nodes.text: WHISPERS FROM THE LIMINAL · ep. 19 · a field guide, left on a park bench
nodes.sub: a park bench · rain · a screen still glowing

nodes.text: Someone found this on a bench in the rain and mailed it to me, which, legally, I think makes it mine.
It calls itself a field guide. To what, it doesn’t say. It’s still running.
A field guide written by a student, left on a park bench. Plasteek pages, slick and glowy with rain, animated menus and transitions unspooling in an endless loop.
The menu loops. 0. the fool. i. the magician. ii. the high priestess. Then the fool again. It never gets past two.
Inside the cover, the name is rubbed out. The class period isn’t. Fourth.
some part of you finds a hole, and crawls into.

arrive at a time in life where all answers dry up
days stretch long &
night creeps into a stretch of- well- forever.

relationships dried out like butcher paper onion skin
a future tense that’s all but spent.

come with me prolapsed children of the mind.
the soma solipsism hurts only so much as you want it to.
It stops at the priestess every time. I’ve decided not to take that personally. The battery should have died weeks ago. Goodnight.
